## The three published-source cases: each value next to its source

| Case | Value in `expected.json` | Raw source (quoted in `source/excerpt.md`) |

| **TC-52**, Marchenko–Pastur edge (STRUC-01) | For N = 500, T = 504: the edge equals the formula. For N = 250, T = 1000: **λmax = 2.25, λmin = 0.25** | Laloux et al. (1999), Eq. (3): "λ^max_min = σ²(1 + 1/Q ± 2√(1/Q)) … Q = T/N … σ² … equal to 1". With Q = 4 that's 1 + 0.25 ± 2(0.5), which gives **2.25 and 0.25** |
| **TC-53**, HRP on the paper's example (PORT-04) | **0.0700, 0.0759, 0.1084, 0.1903, 0.0972, 0.1019, 0.0662, 0.0910, 0.0712, 0.1279** for series 1 to 10 | Exhibit 7, HRP column: "7.00%, 7.59%, 10.84%, 19.03%, 9.72%, 10.19%, 6.62%, 9.10%, 7.12%, 12.79%" |
| **TC-54**, minimum variance on the same input (PORT-02) | **0.1444, 0.1993, 0.1973, 0.1987, 0.1868, 0, 0.0586, 0.0149, 0, 0** | Exhibit 7, CLA column: "14.44%, 19.93%, 19.73%, 19.87%, 18.68%, 0.00%, 5.86%, 1.49%, 0.00%, 0.00%". CLA is minimum variance with "0 ≤ wi ≤ 1 … ∑wi = 1" |

How the TC-53 and TC-54 input is rebuilt:
